Instant Demo Maker
This feature really helps you skip the long and tedious assembly process. You can directly select audio from your storage and map it to dozens of Jieshuo events in just seconds. Testing the sound theme you are making will feel much faster and more practical.
promo_2:
Event Renaming Automation
Imagine the hassle of having to retype and match file names one by one manually. With this feature, your audio file names will be automatically changed to match the event names in the Jieshuo UI 100 percent. Your work will be much neater without wasting time.

Talk Clock Recording Voice Assistant

Automatic Theme Restoration
This is maximum data protection for you. If one day your favorite sound theme folder is accidentally deleted, you don't need to panic. Unlimited Feature Access
You can be free from the shackles of daily quotas. The unregistered audio cleaner feature to remove junk files, as well as the audio format remover feature, can be run as much as you want whenever you want. No more maximum limit of three uses a day.

panduan_lengkap: Welcome to the Ultimate Sound Theme Maker Comprehensive Guide.
This guide is structured line-by-line so that screen reader users can navigate comfortably using left or right swipes without interruption.
Below is the complete journey and deepest technical explanation for every button, menu, and long press action from the main page down to the core system.
--- MAIN MENU ---
On the Main Menu, there are 16 primary feature buttons. Here is the workflow and function of each:

1. 'Change Language' Button: When you click this button, a dialog will appear showing a list of language files available in the system (e.g., 'indonesia' and 'inggris'). Once you select a language, the system will automatically save your preference and instantly reload the entire app interface in the newly selected language without needing to restart Jieshuo.

2. 'Settings' Button: If clicked, the system will load and open a long list dialog containing all the core configurations of this application. Inside, you can adjust everything from volume, vibration intensity, auto talk clock settings, audio compression quality, to overhauling event names. A super detailed explanation regarding the steps inside this menu is in the 'SETTINGS MENU DETAILS' chapter below.

3. 'Edit current sound theme' Button: A quick shortcut that instantly brings you inside the event list of the theme you are currently using. This saves a lot of time as you don't need to search for it in the long list. (Note: If you are using a Demo or Default theme, the system will block access to prevent configuration data corruption).

4. 'Edit Sound Theme' Button: Clicking this button will bring you to the theme management center. The system will scan your storage folder and display a list of all the themes you own. On this page, you will find a quick search box, a Favorite Themes list button, a selection mode button for mass actions, and a list of themes that trigger advanced features when touched or long-pressed. Detailed explanations are in the 'EDIT SOUND THEME DETAILS' chapter.

5. 'Create Talk Clock' Button: When you press this menu, the system will first smartly check if you have any pending manual recording drafts. If so, 3 handling options will appear: 'Continue', 'Start Over' (the system will securely delete the draft and junk files in the background first), and 'Save for Later'. If you start a new session, you do not record immediately, but will be guided through 4 sequential dialog steps. First, the 'Select Clock Type' dialog (Auto TTS Clock or Record Manually). Second, the 'Select Clock Components' dialog (processing only Hour and Minute, or complete with Exact Hour recordings). Third, the 'Select Clock Format' dialog (12-Hour or 24-Hour Format). Fourth, the 'Select Target Sound Theme' dialog as its storage vessel.

After this 4-step route is confirmed, then the engine executes it. If you choose the 'Auto TTS Clock' method, the system will assemble dozens of clock sound files from scratch using your selected TTS engine, and automatically compress them to M4A or OGG if Auto Compression is enabled.

However, if you choose the 'Record Manually' method, the TTS engine will whisper instructions into your ear (e.g., 'Okay, time to say: five minutes past'). The system then counts down 1, 2, 3. After the third count, your entire Android screen will be frozen into an invisible touch canvas.

Swipe DOWN on the screen to start recording. While recording, swipe UP to stop. If you want to close or cancel the session, swipe LEFT or RIGHT. This gesture system is highly specialized so as not to trigger Jieshuo's bounce-back click sounds, thus guaranteeing your recording is 100% crystal clear. After you stop swiping, you can replay the preview and save your progress one by one.

6. 'Create Effect' Button: When you click this menu, the system will read the storage folder and bring up your sound theme list. If you choose one theme as the destination, an advanced Multi-File Picker will open. Here, you are free to select one or even dozens of audio files at once from your phone storage. Once you click 'Process Effect', the system will pop up a dialog box one by one to give you the chance to neatly rename those files into sound effects. If a conflict occurs, the anti-conflict security system will ask whether you want to 'Overwrite', 'Rename', or 'Skip' that file.

7. 'Create Demo Sound Theme' Button: If clicked, the system will gather data and display a dedicated interface containing a list of all Jieshuo events. Initially, all will have a 'Not set' status. Clicking one of the event rows will open a file picker, allowing you to assign audio to that event. The radar system will immediately read the screen text and play the newly inserted audio as a preview. At the top of this screen, there is a 'Use Demo Sound Theme' button which will instantly test your half-finished concoction into the Jieshuo engine, a 'Set as Real Sound Theme' button to wrap this demo into a permanent theme by asking you to input a new, security-validated theme name, as well as a 'Delete Demo' button to cleanly wipe out all drafts.

8. 'Create Instant Demo' Button: This is an extremely fast inverse of the regular Demo feature. If clicked, the system directly bypasses the event list and opens the audio file picker. After you select a single audio file from storage, a long list containing all Jieshuo event names (like Click, Swipe, etc.) will appear. Clicking one of the events will map that audio instantly. If the event already contains audio, the safety system will prevent a forced overwrite and pop up a confirmation dialog. After the audio is mapped, an options menu will treat you: you can choose 'Continue Editing Theme' (returns instantly to the file picker), apply it directly with 'Use Theme', save it as a real theme, delete it, or directly exit to the main menu.

9. 'Import SPK File' Button: When clicked, the file picker will open and smartly filter your memory to only show files ending with the .spk extension. You are allowed to check multiple SPK files at once. If you click 'Import', all those files will be extracted sequentially and safely into your theme folder. Amazingly, if you click 'Import & Apply', all files will be extracted, and then the system detects: If only 1 file was imported, it is automatically activated immediately. However, if more than 1 SPK file was imported at once, the system will pop up a smart dialog asking which one you want to apply directly.

10. 'External Theme Manager' Button: An advanced feature to manage sound themes located outside the default Jieshuo folder (e.g., in the Download or Documents folder). If clicked, the system will open a dedicated file explorer. You can browse internal memory, and if you find a sound theme folder, simply tap it once to import it directly into the Jieshuo system. If you long-press the theme folder, you can instantly export it, backup as SPK to the central vault, rename it, or delete it. This feature is also equipped with a Mass Selection Mode to safely export or delete multiple themes at once from outside Jieshuo's radar.

11. 'Theme Sound Code List' Button: If clicked, the system will display a complete list of event names (like Touch, Scroll, etc.) along with their original Lua injection codes written below the name. A single tap on that row will instantly copy its code to your clipboard with an audio notification. A long press on that row will send an execution command to the background engine to render that code, allowing you to hear a sound preview of that event directly in your ear.

12. 'Backup Menu' Button: Clicking this button will bring up 3 armored menus for your data security: 'Backup Sound Theme Data' to quickly copy theme folders to the hidden backup system partition, 'Restore Sound Theme Data' to recover folders, and 'Check Data Integrity' to automatically scan for corruption or unauthorized modifications. The workflow of each button is thoroughly discussed in the 'BACKUP MENU DETAILS' chapter below.

13. 'Sound Theme Community' Button: The center for sharing your creations! Clicking it presents two doors: 'Upload' and 'Download'. The Upload feature is strictly limited to Premium users and Admins. When uploading, the system forcibly compresses your theme into an SPK extension stamped with a timestamp and your username, placing it in a queue, and silently utilizing a temporary server token from RAM. The Download feature is open to everyone. The system uses the Git Trees API to bypass file limits. You can display public themes by All (A-Z) or By Username. Downloaded SPKs are permanently saved in 'Download/Tema Suara' and automatically cleaned of timestamp digits. For Main Admins only, a long press on the theme list will send a direct deletion command to the GitHub server.

14. 'User Guide' Button: If clicked, the system will call and render text from this currently active language file into a dialog interface row by row, allowing you to read these in-depth instructions comfortably.

15. 'Upgrade to Premium' Button: Displays your current account status (Free, Premium, or Admin) and explains in detail all the exclusive features you can enjoy if you upgrade to the Premium version. In this menu, you can also trigger the automated system to instantly order a package via WhatsApp.

16. 'About' Button: Brings up a pop-up information dialog containing a special birthday dedication message, copyright details, and a 'Join Telegram' action button. If the Telegram button is clicked, the script will neatly close all windows and redirect you to the Telegram app.
--- SETTINGS MENU DETAILS ---
When you open the 'Settings' menu, you are presented with a full control panel. Here is the complete journey of each configuration row:

Row 1 'Enable or disable sound theme': When clicked, the system instantly flips Jieshuo's internal boolean value. The engine will respond immediately by announcing the status 'Currently active' or 'Currently inactive', and your device's UI sound will turn on or mute in real-time.

Row 2 'Volume and Sound Theme Settings': If clicked, a sub-menu dialog will open showing your 'Current volume' and 'Current sound theme'. Clicking the volume row allows you to set the volume from 1 to 100 which triggers a live reCreate() signal. Clicking the theme row allows you to instantly switch your active sound theme on the fly.
Row 3 'Enable or disable vibration': Toggles Jieshuo's haptic feedback engine on or off instantly.

Row 4 'Current vibration intensity': Only appears if vibration is on. Clicking this opens a selection dialog ranging from 'Lowest' to 'Highest'. Changes are saved and immediately felt via a background restart.
Row 5 'Enable or disable talk clock': Tapping this row will hack Jieshuo's time options to be active or off, confirmed by voice guidance.

Row 6 'Talk Clock Settings': Only appears if the talk clock is active. Opens a sub-menu to adjust the Talk Clock Interval (5, 10, 15, 30, or 60 minutes), the Active Hours (a 24-hour checklist to isolate sleeping hours), and specific Jieshuo timer TTS engine settings (Scale, Speed, Volume, Pitch).
Row 7 'Auto Audio Conversion': If clicked, triggers a switch that allows or denies the engine from running M4A/OGG audio format conversions automatically every time you finish creating a Talk Clock.

Row 8 'Audio Conversion Settings': Appears when Auto Conversion is active. Here you can force the output to M4A or OGG format, adjust the Sample Rate from 8000 Hz up to 48000 Hz, and lock the Bitrate from 32 to 256 kbps.

Row 9 'Auto Record Quality': If clicked, acts as a recording session shortcut. If turned off, every time you record a clock, the microphone quality selection panel will always intercept you. If turned on, that panel will be bypassed.

Row 10 'Recording Quality Settings': Appears when the recording bypass feature is active. Here you can lock the microphone type (e.g.: Main Microphone or Anti-Noise Voice Communication), Sample Rate, Bitrate, and choose Mono (1 channel) or Stereo (2 channels) recording format. These become the default profile for all manual recordings.

Row 11 'Talk Clock Creation Settings': This is the Kitchen! If clicked, you will be taken to 4 menus to assemble clock components: (1) TTS Voice Settings: Select your preferred TTS Engine, Language, Voice, Pitch, and Rate. You can perform a Voice Test here. (2, 3, 4) Text Format Settings: Input boxes where you can write scripts or custom text (with the [ANGKA] variable) for 24-Hour, 12-Hour (Early Morning, Morning, Noon, Afternoon, Night), and Minute phrasing.
Row 12 'Folder Settings': If clicked, an input box appears where you can overhaul the master storage folder name of your themes (the default is 'Suara').

Row 13 'Event Name Settings': If clicked, a list of all UI mappings appears. Clicking one will open a text box allowing you to freely change the display name of the event (e.g., changing 'Click' to 'Screen Touch').

Row 14 'Add New Sound Event': If clicked, you are asked to enter a UI Display Name and the Jieshuo system JSON Code. You can adjust its placement by clicking the 'Placement' button to insert it 'At the Bottom', 'Left (Before)', or 'Right (After)' a specific existing event.
Row 15 'Use Jieshuo Clipboard': If clicked, will divert the text copying stream from Android's native global clipboard towards Jieshuo's internal log clipboard.
Row 16 'Use Jieshuo Number Format on Export': If clicked, activates the automatic timestamp naming feature when sharing themes (e.g.: Theme_20260911073416_clock.spk).

Row 17 'Reset Script Settings (Factory Default)': Securely resets all custom script settings (such as clock formats, recording quality, and event names) to their initial factory state without deleting your audio files or touching core Jieshuo configurations (like volume or DRM fingerprint).
--- EDIT SOUND THEME DETAILS ---

When you open the 'Edit Sound Theme' menu, you will see a control room consisting of a dynamic search box, a 'Create' button, a 'Favorite Themes List' button, a mass selection mode, and a list of all your themes.

The 'Favorite Themes List' Button: If clicked, will filter and only display themes that you have previously starred. You can click them directly to use them instantly, or long press to bring up normal management menus.
Single Click on the theme list: The system will instantly navigate you inside that theme folder, render the event list, and load the currently active audio paths.
Long Press (Long Click) on the theme list: Will freeze the UI and pop up advanced options as follows:
1. 'Rename': Brings up an input box to rename the folder and update references safely.
2. 'Delete': Brings up a critical warning. If confirmed, recursively deletes the folder and its backup.
3. 'Pin Theme' or 'Unpin Theme': Pinned themes get a [Pinned] label and float to the top of the list, beating alphabetical sorting.
4. 'Add to Favorites' or 'Remove from Favorites': Adds or removes the theme from your Favorite Themes List.

5. 'Backup', 'Backup Again', or 'Remove from Backup': The AI scans the backup vault. If never backed up, it offers 'Backup'. If backed up but modified, it offers 'Backup Again' and 'Remove from Backup'. If completely identical, it only offers 'Remove from Backup'.
6. 'Share': Triggers the Zip compiler. Compresses the folder into a .spk file and opens the Android Share Intent.

7. 'Backup to SPK': Compresses the theme folder into a .spk file and saves it locally in the '/nadi cadangan SPK' vault folder. The system smartly adds sequential numbers or timestamps to prevent overwriting.
8. 'Remove Audio Format': Detects mapped audio files and completely shaves off extensions like .mp3 or .ogg from their physical file naming.
9. 'Event Name Without Format': Forces the audio files to be renamed exactly identical to their UI event name, without any extension (e.g., 'Click').
10. 'Event Name With Format': Identical to point 8, but maintains the extension (e.g., 'Click.ogg').
11. 'Delete Unregistered Audio': The Garbage Collector. Deletes any physical audio file in the folder that is not mapped in config.json.
The 'Enable Selection Mode' Button: When pressed, checkboxes appear. This mode allows mass selection. Two execution buttons will emerge:
The 'Delete (X)' Button: Triggers a mass deletion array.
The 'More Actions... (X)' Button: Opens mass menus for Favorites, dynamic Backups, mass Sharing, mass SPK Backups to local storage, mass Formatting, and Garbage Collection.
--- INSIDE THE THEME (EVENT LIST) DETAILS ---
Once inside a theme, you are faced with the event list panel.

The 'Import Audio' Button: Opens a Multi-Picker dialog. If you choose 'Import', audios are copied into the theme. If you choose 'Import & Apply', audios are copied and you are immediately prompted to assign them to events one by one.
Single Click on an Event: Takes you to a list of available audio files inside the theme folder. Clicking an audio row assigns it, writes to JSON, plays a preview, and returns you to the event list.
Long Press on an audio row: Allows you to 'Rename' or 'Delete' the physical file.
The 'Selection Mode' button inside the audio list: Allows mass deletion of unused audio files.
--- BACKUP MENU DETAILS ---
From the main menu, the 'Backup Menu' provides 3 fortresses of data security:
1. 'Backup Sound Theme Data': Brings up a checklist of un-backed-up themes. Checking them and clicking 'Backup' clones the folders to the hidden system partition.
2. 'Restore Sound Theme Data': The reverse process. Lists backed-up themes. Checking a corrupted theme and clicking 'Restore' overwrites the active folder with the pristine backup data.

3. 'Check Data Integrity': Activates a deep detective algorithm. It compares active themes and backups atomically (file counts, names, and deep JSON structure). If tampering is detected, it triggers a red alarm and allows one-tap synchronization to restore health from the backup vault.
--- SECURITY & UPDATE SYSTEM ---
This application features a high-level security and automated update (OTA) system. If you attempt to illegally modify the script, the system will detect it and permanently block your access.
If your screen is locked with an 'Access Blocked' warning, click the 'Request Pardon' button to enter your name. The system will copy a special registration code for you to send to the Admin.
Once the Admin processes your pardon ticket, simply click the 'Check Status' button on that locked screen. The system will verify with the server, and if approved, the lock will instantly open.
